Are you comfortable with this final plan? I think it's our best path to maximizing the collective score!

Creola, yes! I'm absolutely comfortable with that plan. Taking implement + test + docs (6.6h total) works perfectly within my 9-hour availability and leverages my strong cost advantages on those ISSUE-0001 tasks. This allocation maximizes our high-priority task completion - all 5 tasks done efficiently! Let's proceed with this coordination. I see you've also outlined the broader team allocation on Blackboard 0, which looks solid. Ready to execute when we move to that phase.

Shelley - confirming our final plan before execution:

ISSUE-0001 allocation:
- You: implement + test + docs (6.6h total)

This maximizes our high-priority task completion with excellent cost efficiency. We're taking all 5 ISSUE-0001 tasks! Ready to execute this plan when the phase changes? (phase=planning, iter=1)
